Tests ability to design cross-tenant data pipelines with edge-to-cloud ingestion, streaming ETL, and governed analytics in Azure. Emphasizes security, governance, and cost controls across subscriptions and a partner tenant.

## Key Concepts
- IoT Hub/Event Hubs to ADLS Gen2 landing zone

- Cross-tenant access via Azure Lighthouse
- Private Endpoints for data isolation
- Governance: Azure Policy + Purview data catalog
- Terraform CI/CD with GitHub Actions; daily budget alerts

## Code Example
```hcl
# Terraform skeleton for an Azure Private Endpoint to ADLS Gen2 (simplified)
resource "azurerm_private_endpoint" "lake_pe" {
  name                = "lake-private-endpoint"
  location            = var.location
  resource_group_name = azurerm_resource_group.rg.name
  subnet_id           = azurerm_subnet.pe_subnet.id
  private_service_connection {
    name                           = "lake-conn"
    is_manual_connection           = false
    private_connection_resource_id = azurerm_storage_account.datalake.id
    subresource_names              = ["file"]
  }
}
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you validate cross-tenant RBAC before production go-live?
- What telemetry would you collect to verify data lineage and cost efficiency?
